meta.purpose: Global variable type evidence that outranks the IDA-plate prefix default. pass_globals defaults `dword_X` to `unsigned int`; the original function's own comparison instruction can PROVE the value is signed (MSVC canonicalizes int-vs-unsigned to an unsigned compare, so a signed jcc over the loaded value means every operand of that compare is signed).
meta.evidence_rule: entry exists only when a function's original disasm compares the loaded global with a SIGNED jcc (jl/jle/jg/jge) and the emitted code produced the unsigned twin (jb/jbe/ja/jae). Type is the signed spelling of the same width.
